scan_table_check.description:
Flags Script Includes whose name does not match the regular expression in the system property instance_scan.peer_review.names.script_include (currently ^[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$ on dev284560). Nothing is reported when the property is empty; an invalid pattern is reported on every Script Include so it gets fixed.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Check Script Include Name" and reads the same property.
scan_table_check.name: SN-SI-001: Script Include name does not follow the naming convention
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Rename the Script Include (and every reference to it) to match the convention in the system property instance_scan.peer_review.names.script_include.
scan_table_check.short_description: A Script Include name does not match the configured naming pattern.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-SI-001: Script Include name does not follow the naming convention
